module_summary: AXI-Stream broadcaster: an input skid buffer feeds NM per-output FIFOs written simultaneously only when none is full; each FIFO drives one master stream.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Input stream valid into skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Input stream ready from skid buffer, backpressured by full FIFOs.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Input stream payload captured by skid buffer.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Per-output valid vector, asserted when that output FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Per-output ready vector; pops the corresponding FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Concatenated output payloads read from each output FIFO.

anchors.name: axis_ready
anchors.why: Broadcast write enable: skid valid and no FIFO full; writes all FIFOs.

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: Per-FIFO full vector; any full bit blocks the broadcast.

anchors.name: skd_data
anchors.why: Skid buffer output data written into every output FIFO.

anchors.name: skd_valid
anchors.why: Skid buffer output valid qualifying the broadcast write.

anchors.name: OUTGOING_FIFOS[*].fifo_empty
anchors.why: Per-output FIFO empty flag inverted into M_AXIS_TVALID.

groups.name: input_skid_buffer
groups.description: Skid buffer registering the input stream so ready can depend on FIFO fullness.

groups.name: broadcast_control
groups.description: Writes all output FIFOs together only when none is full.

groups.name: output_fifos
groups.description: Per-master FIFOs each driving one output stream independently.
